name: rabbit-writes
description: Rabbit writes: a personal writing voice plus an AI-pattern detection engine, installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: rabbit-writes
plugins.description: Write and edit in your own voice, not a chatbot's. Ships three skills: rabbit-writes (draft, convert, de-slop, or audit prose in the active voice, four modes over a shared detection and craft engine), voice-setup (build or swap a voice profile), and readme-writing (draft or audit a README.md against patterns measured from 100 real GitHub repos).
